# Bean playground

> A fully static, backend-free build of the Bean application compiler and
> semantic-content renderer. The real Go compiler runs as WebAssembly inside a
> Web Worker; this page never issues `/api` requests.

## For agents

This page is an agent surface. Two interchangeable interfaces expose the same
tools — use whichever your runtime supports:

1. **WebMCP** — when `document.modelContext` exists, the page registers the
   tools below so in-browser agents (e.g. a Gemini sidebar agent) can call them
   natively.
2. **`window.bean`** — always present; callable from JavaScript:

   ```js
   await bean.compile({
     files: {'app.yaml': 'apiVersion: bean/v1alpha1\nname: Demo\n...'},
     manifest: 'app.yaml',
   })
   ```

`bean.webmcp` reports whether WebMCP registration succeeded; `bean.tools` lists
the registered tool names.

## Tools

- `bean_state()` → `{manifest, files: {path: {bytes}}, app, diagnostics, unsupported, route}` — current editor sources, compiled app summary, and preview route.
- `bean_compile({files?, manifest?})` → `{ok, diagnostics, app, error}` — compile sources with the real Go compiler. Passing `files` replaces the editor sources (composing a new app); omitting them recompiles the current ones. The preview and `bean_state().app` update only when `diagnostics` is empty.
- `bean_render({path, query?})` → `{ok, tree, unsupported, error}` — render one route to the Bean semantic tree. Backend-dependent components arrive as `UnsupportedBlock` entries, never simulated.
- `bean_navigate({path})` → `{ok, path}` — switch the on-screen preview to a route.
- `bean_list_examples()` → `[{name, title}]` — bundled example apps.
- `bean_load_example({name})` → `{load, files, manifest}` — load a bundled example and compile it.

## Source contract

- `files` maps relative paths to UTF-8 text; `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.json` only — no `..`, no absolute paths, ≤64 files, ≤256 KiB each, ≤1 MiB total.
- `manifest` names the entry document (typically `app.yaml`); it is a multi-document YAML stream of Bean `kind:` resources (`App`, `Block`, `Panel`, `Page`, `Sequence`, `View`, `Action`, `Menu`, `Theme`).
- Diagnostics carry stable `BEAN-*` codes plus `source: {path, line, column}`; failures return `error: {code: 'BEAN-P41xx'|'BEAN-P42xx', message}`.
- Everything lives in memory only — edits do not persist across reloads.

## Links

- Renderable examples: `examples/index.json`, `examples/<name>.json` ({manifest, files} bundles).
- Full documentation: `docs/playground.md` in the Bean repository.
